description:
• Brand introduction: Koppi's Online Store is your go-to destination for high-quality pet products and stylish apparel. We offer a diverse range of items, from premium pet apparel, collars, leashes, and toys to chic clothing and accessories for men and women. Our mission is to enhance the lives of pets and their owners by providing fashionable, functional, and durable products. With a focus on excellent customer service and fast shipping, Koppi's Online Store ensures a seamless shopping experience for every customer.


• Product description:  At Koppi's Online Store, we pride ourselves on offering a carefully curated selection of products that cater to both pets and their owners. Our collections include:

  • Pet Products: Stylish and durable apparel, collars, leashes, and toys that make every pet's life more enjoyable.
  • Men’s and Women’s Apparel: Trendy and comfortable clothing, perfect for any occasion.
  • Seasonal Collections: Specially designed to meet the needs of each season, offering both warmth and style.


• USP (Unique Selling Point): Koppi's Online Store stands out with its unique blend of fashion and functionality, ensuring that every product not only looks good but also serves a purpose. Our pet products are crafted with the highest quality materials, ensuring durability and comfort, while our apparel collections for men and women are designed to keep up with the latest trends. Our dedication to customer satisfaction and fast shipping makes us a reliable choice for online shopping. 


• Payment terms: We offer a competitive commission rate for our affiliates, with prompt payments made on a monthly basis. Affiliates earn a percentage of each sale made through their unique referral links, with no limits on earning potential. Payments are processed through a secure and convenient method, ensuring affiliates are rewarded fairly and on time.


• Other information: 

  • Affiliate Support: We provide comprehensive support to our affiliates, including marketing materials, promotional guidance, and direct assistance from our affiliate management team.
  • Tracking and Reporting: Our affiliate program uses advanced tracking technology to ensure every sale is accurately recorded. Affiliates have access to a detailed dashboard for tracking their performance and earnings.
  • Exclusive Promotions: Affiliates will have access to special promotions and discounts that they can offer to their audience, increasing the chances of conversions.
